items.title: U.S. eyes refining muscle of Indian billionaire Ambani's Reliance as Rubio visits Jamnagar plant
items.sum: Rubio said the "extraordinary" refining capacity of Reliance could help India diversify its energy supplies, hinting at greater offtake of Venezuelan crude.

items.title: UK government expected to approve Jackdaw gas field
items.sum: The long-awaited decision about the controversial North Sea field is expected on Wednesday morning.

items.title: Why does Elon Musk want to merge Tesla and SpaceX?
items.sum: Musk, who is CEO of both companies, says there is "a lot to be gained" from the merger, which would be the biggest in history.

items.title: Australian data center operator NextDC's shares plunge 40% after it slashes earnings forecast
items.sum: The company cited power supply delays at its Melbourne facility amid local community and stakeholder opposition for lowering earnings forecast.

items.title: CNBC Daily Open: The Musk universe is planning its latest crossover
items.sum: In the corporate world, Elon Musk is mulling a more ambitious merger of universes: SpaceX and Tesla.

items.title: Elice's huge stock swings show AI's spending boom is getting more investor scrutiny
items.sum: The AI boom is entering a more unforgiving phase, as investors question whether the billions poured into data centers will translate into sustainable profits.

items.title: Car buyers are demanding lower prices and better tech. Automakers must deliver both
items.sum: Bain says tech leads purchase considerations in China while price remains No. 1 in the U.S. and Europe, as pressure mounts on Western carmakers.

items.title: Japan exports post huge miss in September as growth slows to 16.7%
items.sum: Japan's imports grew 18.9%, also missing expectations of 19.6% from Reuters.

items.title: Bull markets tend to peak with a whimper, not a bang — but a 15% correction for the S&P 500 may be next
items.sum: Unlike bear-market bottoms, which typically end with a spasm of despair as traders throw in the towel, bull-market tops are far more gradual and less dramatic.

items.title: Super Micro’s stock soars after surprise update — with Dell and HPE shares joining the rally
items.sum: Super Micro unexpectedly disclosed that its revenue and profitability could be much stronger than originally anticipated.

items.title: Tesla’s stock rises as Elon Musk drops new clues about a possible SpaceX merger
items.sum: Special committees at both companies are assessing merger prospects but a combination is no sure thing, Musk says.

items.title: Netflix vows to revive viewership trends, but investors hit ‘sell’ on the stock
items.sum: Streaming service cites “intense competition’ and acknowledges ‘some investor concern about our view hours growth.”

items.title: Elon Musk says Tesla-SpaceX merger being considered
items.sum: Musk says special committees within both companies have been formed to look at a possible mega-merger.

items.title: Elon Musk ordered Starlink slowdown for Ukraine: Report
items.sum: Musk and President Donald Trump have both recently criticized Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, who has also flagged disruptions in U.S. intel sharing.

items.title: Netflix posts third-quarter earnings beat, but shares fall on advertising and revenue guidance
items.sum: Wall Street and investors will be looking for Netflix to provide additional details about the company's strategy following recent organizational changes

items.title: Salesforce announces $5.66 billion deal for Braze, sending BRZE stock soaring 51%
items.sum: The company's latest acquisition is expected to close in fiscal 2028, and will see Braze shareholders receive $47.50 in cash per share.
